name_zh: 中文文档表格抽取与字段校验
profession_zh: 中文文档表格抽取与字段校验
desc_zh: 为需要处理中文文档的开发者与数据团队，从中文 PDF、扫描件、Excel、Word 中批量抽取结构化表格与关键字段，并自动校验金额、日期、编号格式、合计勾稽与重复行，输出带页码行列溯源的可机读记录。触发词：中文PDF表格提取、中文发票识别、保单信息提取、对账单解析、表格字段校验、中文文档结构化。
desc_en: For developers and data teams processing Chinese documents: batch-extract structured tables and key fields from Chinese PDF, scans, Excel and Word, then auto-validate amounts, dates, identifier formats, total reconciliation and duplicate rows, emitting machine-readable records with page/row/column traceability. Triggers: Chinese PDF table extraction, Chinese invoice recognition, insurance policy field extraction, bank statement parsing, table field validation, Chinese document structuring.
